machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket `fwrd80-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, detail URL `#/tickets/t15`). Only required field was Title; Customer was optional and left blank. Status started as Draft.

**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd80-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 × 1.25).

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd80-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 × 1.25). Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (150 × 1.25). Parts total became $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app refused the first "Mark Ready" attempt with a verbatim alert:
> "Ticket is not ready / Part "fwrd80-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd80-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

**What was required:** every part on the ticket must have a supplier. I set Supplier = "Acme Supply" on both parts (via each part's Edit dialog, all other values unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" was accepted with no error. Status control read "Ready", and the offered status actions changed from "Mark Ready / Archive ticket" to "Mark Draft / Mark Closed".

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via its Delete action, confirmed in an in-page "Confirm" dialog with Cancel/Delete part buttons). Parts table now reads exactly "No parts on this ticket yet." with no Total row. Ticket then archived via "Archive ticket" (accepted directly, no confirmation dialog; button became "Unarchive ticket"). Detail page shows "Status: Ready" with an "Archived" badge. With "Show archived" unchecked, searching the tickets list for "fwrd80-n1" returns "No tickets match the current filters." — nothing from this run remains active. The ticket only appears when "Show archived" is ticked, as: `RD-1015 | fwrd80-n1 RD Bench Ticket | Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-21`.
